description: Engines MIRA can route to. Each is an independent open-source project with a pinned commit so installs are reproducible. Nothing is bundled — install with install-integrations.sh.

engines.name: edge-tts
engines.role: MIRA's main voice. Microsoft neural voices over a free public endpoint: expressive, natural prosody, no API key, no cost. This is what keeps her from sounding robotic.

engines.name: Faster-Whisper
engines.role: Server-side ears. Whisper through CTranslate2: accurate, private, works without internet after the model downloads once. Used by POST /api/stt.

engines.name: openWakeWord
engines.role: Ear-drums. A tiny neural net that listens for a wake phrase locally, with no audio leaving the device. Groundwork for a hands-free "Mira" trigger in the Android build.

engines.name: mem0
engines.role: Optional upgrade for memory. mem0 adds fact extraction and conflict resolution on top of a vector/graph store. MIRA ships with her own SQLite memory so she works without it; install this when you want richer recall.

engines.name: Open Interpreter
engines.role: Deep-task engine. Takes a natural-language goal and runs real code on the machine — files, shells, data work. MIRA's built-in agent covers the safe subset; this is the heavy hammer for when you want more.
engines.install_hint: pip install open-interpreter   (needs OPENAI_API_KEY or a local model)
